name: Sustainable Catalyst Workspace
change_summary: Collaboration Architecture Foundation adds explicit actors, project ownership policies, descriptive capability grants, canonical-target comments, review proposals, and shareable-project contracts.
manual_notes: Storage 35 / Project 20.0 remain schema-stable. Collaboration architecture is browser-local. Roles and capability grants describe intended responsibility but do not create server permissions. Comments and proposals reference canonical project/object IDs. Accepting a proposal records a review decision only and never applies the proposed change automatically. Shareable-project contracts include ownership, scope IDs, and grants but no project content. Live co-editing and organization membership remain out of scope. The 4px editorial header rule is retained.
